title: Almost everywhere invariance of Gaussian noise
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\rho\in[-1,1]$, and let $f,g:\mathbb R^n\to\mathbb R$ agree almost everywhere under the product standard Gaussian measure. Their images under the Gaussian noise operator at parameter $\rho$ also agree almost everywhere under that measure.
hypotheses_covered: $f=g$ almost everywhere under the product standard Gaussian measure
